dedupe_keys.name: mapping global onshore wind turbines using multi source remote sensing images and hybrid learning approaches

description: This global onshore wind inventory is published by researchers at the Chinese Academy of Sciences and Curtin University. The repository reports 416,532 turbine locations with country and land-use attributes in a geospatial shapefile. Its method combines OpenStreetMap with Google Earth and Sentinel-1/2 imagery, using ResNet-18 and Random Forest classifiers. Zenodo also lists a PyTorch classifier archive, pretrained weights and Google Earth Engine code, alongside the GonshoreWT2024 data archive and a README. The record was published in 2026 under CC-BY-4.0 and is freely accessible. The archive name contains 2024, but the precise observation window was not established from the landing metadata and should be checked before temporal analysis. Detected locations do not establish electrical connectivity, turbine capacity or operational status. The inventory could supply asset points for hazard overlays, land-use comparisons and spatial energy-capacity scenarios when joined to suitable engineering attributes. It complements data-global-renewables-watch-solar-wind with individual onshore turbine points, not an interchangeable measurement of generating capacity.
